name: Usachi
source:
The first fluff you talk to when you first arrive at Fluffland. It's friendly and loves to help people. It acts as your guide in Fluffland. It currently lives in your neighborhood.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fluffness/fluffland]Kickstarter[/url]]
